# AMC Marquee Links

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**List Template** for Universal Theme · direction: motion · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

An announcement ticker: the list's links glide past in a seamless loop with faded edges and a live pulse, and pause on hover, keyboard focus or the pause button.

**Use it for:** A single strip of announcements, quick links or partner and supplier links at the top of a home page, portal or dashboard; 4 to 12 short entries.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_marquee_links.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/list-templates/amc-marquee-links.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

Create or pick a List (Shared Components > Lists), add a **List** region and set **Appearance > List Template** to **AMC Marquee Links**. In APEXlang: `componentAppearance { listTemplate: @amc-marquee-links }`.

List template for an announcement or quick-link ticker. The entries scroll sideways in a seamless loop (the JavaScript file repeats the entries with copies that are hidden from screen readers and skipped by the Tab key), reverse direction in right-to-left languages, and pause while the pointer is over the strip, while a link has keyboard focus, or after the pause button is pressed. Use the Tag attribute (A01) for a short label such as New, Due today or Partner shown as a chip before the text. Template options: Slow and Fast change the speed, Reverse scrolls the other way, Band paints a solid primary-color strip, and Plain removes the frame for use inside a page header. Without JavaScript, and under reduced motion, the entries sit still as a wrapped row of links. The pause button label is English text in the After List Entries template; translate it there if needed.

## List entry attributes

| Attribute | Meaning |
|---|---|
| A01 | Tag |

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Slow | `amc-TMarqueeLinks--slow` | Scrolls at about 60 percent of the normal speed, for longer texts. |
| Fast | `amc-TMarqueeLinks--fast` | Scrolls at about 1.7 times the normal speed, for short logos and names. |
| Reverse | `amc-TMarqueeLinks--reverse` | Scrolls in the opposite direction. |
| Band | `amc-TMarqueeLinks--band` | A solid strip in the primary color with contrast text, like a news band. |
| Plain | `amc-TMarqueeLinks--plain` | No background, border or pulse; the ticker blends into a page header or hero. |
